name: Rotaprice Pricing Wheel
author: Pricing Wheel

sections.description:
Rotaprice Pricing Wheel turns a pricing table into something visitors actually want to touch. Plans sit on a wheel. Tap or swipe to switch, and the price in the middle, the plan card and the highlighted column in the feature table change with it.

Why use it

  • Clear for visitors: one plan at a time, price always visible, no horizontal scrolling on phones.
  • Simple for you: one screen to set up plans, prices, buttons and the feature table.
  • Fits your design: day or night mode, your accent color, your theme font or one of 13 included fonts.
  • Light: about 5 KB of JavaScript, no libraries, no jQuery on the website.
  • Private: no cookies, no tracking, no external requests. Fonts are served from your own site.
  • Accessible: keyboard control, screen reader labels, respects reduced-motion settings.

Features

  • 3 plans (sectors) per wheel, as many wheels as you like
  • Price, price suffix, badge, short description and button per plan
  • Feature table with included / not included / free text cells, drag and drop rows
  • Open your own drawer or popup: every button can link to a URL or trigger the booking drawer, checkout or popup you already use, through your own CSS classes and data attributes
  • Day and night mode, accent color per wheel
  • Theme font, system fonts or 13 included open source fonts
  • Responsive: on narrow screens the table turns into a clean list for the selected plan
  • Swipe on touch devices
  • Elementor widget with overrides for mode, accent color, font and table
  • Shortcode and demo content import

Pricing Wheel Pro is a separate paid plugin with 4 to 6 sectors, a price switch (for example Monthly / Yearly), border radius and anonymous statistics. This plugin does not contain that code.

Usage

  1. Go to Pricing Wheel > Add new pricing widget.
  2. Fill in your plans and the feature table, then publish.
  3. Copy the shortcode, for example [pricing_wheel id="123"], into any page, post or block. In Elementor, use the Pricing Wheel widget instead.

Shortcode attributes (all optional): mode="night", accent="#e11d48", font="Poppins", table="0".

Privacy

Pricing Wheel does not collect or store any visitor data, does not set cookies and does not contact any external server. Fonts are included in the plugin and loaded from your own site.

Third-party material

The included fonts are licensed under the SIL Open Font License 1.1 (see assets/fonts/OFL.txt): Inter, Open Sans, Montserrat, Poppins, Nunito, Raleway, Work Sans, DM Sans, Manrope, Outfit, Plus Jakarta Sans, Space Grotesk and Playfair Display, in the Latin subset as distributed by Fontsource (https://fontsource.org). The plugin’s JavaScript and CSS are not minified; there is no build step.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the rotaprice-pricing-wheel folder to /wp-content/plugins/, or install the plugin from Plugins > Add New.
  2. Activate it under Plugins.
  3. Open Pricing Wheel > Demo content and import the examples, or create your own under Add new pricing widget.
sections.faq:
How many plans can a wheel have?

A wheel in this plugin has 3 sectors. A wheel with 4 to 6 sectors is part of Pricing Wheel Pro.

Does it work with Elementor?

Yes. When Elementor is active, a Pricing Wheel widget appears in the panel. Choose a wheel and optionally override mode, accent color, font and table for that placement. The plugin also works without Elementor.

Does it work with the block editor and page builders other than Elementor?

Yes. Add a Shortcode block (or the shortcode element of your builder) and paste [pricing_wheel id="123"].

Can a button open a booking popup or drawer?

Yes. Leave the button URL empty, add a CSS class such as js-open-popup under “Extra CSS classes on CTA buttons” and, per plan, data attributes such as data-popup-id=plan-basic. Your popup or drawer script can bind to them. Nothing else is needed.

What does Pricing Wheel Pro add?

Pricing Wheel Pro is a separate paid plugin. It adds 4 to 6 sectors per wheel, a switch above the wheel (for example Monthly / Yearly, up to 3 options), border radius control and privacy-friendly statistics per plan. See https://pricing-wheel.com/ for details.

Does it use cookies or load anything from other servers?

No. There are no cookies and no external requests. Included fonts are served from your own site.

Which data does the plugin store?

Only the widgets you create (as a custom post type) and one settings option. If you tick “Delete all widgets and settings when the plugin is deleted”, everything is removed on uninstall.
